name: read_file
description: Read a UTF-8 file in the home workspace. Args: path: Absolute, home-relative, or ~/ path.

name: write_file
description: Write a UTF-8 file in the home workspace. This saves text and does not execute code. Args: path: File path. content: Full replacement file contents.

name: list_directory
description: List immediate entries in a workspace directory. Args: path: Directory path.

name: manage_schedule
description: Inspect or update the workspace scheduled job. Args: action: list, remove, or set. run_at: ISO timestamp required for set.
